title: Kestrel Limited Warranty Claims Standard for Vehicle Purchase Agreements
content:
**Section 1 — Coverage period.** Every program under Vehicle Purchase Agreements includes a Kestrel limited warranty. It starts on the handover date and ends at the earlier of the handover date plus the program's included warranty days or the handover odometer plus the program's included warranty miles. A failure is covered only when its failure date and its repair-order odometer are both inside that coverage.

**Section 2 — Order status.** A limited warranty claim is decided only on an order whose status is delivered or completed; a returned, return-pending or cancelled order has no limited warranty.

**Section 3 — What is covered.** The failed part must belong to one of the program's covered systems. Wear items, maintenance, cosmetic items, and damage from collision, misuse or neglect are never covered; such a claim is denied as damage or misuse.

**Section 4 — Authorization.** The repair facility must request authorization within the program's claim report days after the failure date and before work begins. Each repair order is decided once.

**Section 5 — Amount covered.** The repair estimate is recognized at no more than the program's labor rate cap per hour. The covered amount is the recognized estimate less the program's deductible, limited both to the program's per-claim cap and to what remains of the program's aggregate cap after earlier approved claims on the order, and never below zero. A claim with nothing remaining under the aggregate cap is denied as over limit.

**Section 6 — Rental and towing.** An approved claim that keeps the vehicle overnight earns rental reimbursement at the program's rental per day for the approved rental days, up to the program's rental maximum days, and towing to the facility up to the program's towing cap.

**Section 7 — KestrelCare.** When a KestrelCare service contract on the vehicle is also in force, the limited warranty pays first and the service contract pays only what the limited warranty does not.

**Worked example (hypothetical, Kestrel Certified: deductible $0.00, per-claim cap $5000.00, aggregate cap $9000.00).** Earlier approved claims on the order paid $6000.00, leaving $3000.00 under the aggregate cap. A new approved claim with a recognized estimate of $4200.00 is limited to the lesser of $4200.00, $5000.00 and $3000.00: the covered amount is $3000.00. A later claim on the same order finds nothing remaining and is denied as over limit.

**Worked example (hypothetical, Kestrel Inspected: deductible $50.00, rental $35.00 a day up to 3 days).** A recognized estimate of $800.00 gives a covered amount of $750.00. Five approved rental days are reimbursed for 3 days, $105.00.

**Coverage end (hypothetical, Kestrel Value Line: 30 days, 1000 miles; handover on day 0 at 140000 miles).**

| Failure | Inside coverage |
|---|---|
| day 20, odometer 140800 | yes |
| day 20, odometer 141050 | no (past 141000 miles) |
| day 31, odometer 140300 | no (past day 30) |
